info.title: Barzakh AI API
info.description:
API schema for Barzakh AI platform.
This schema is used by Cloudflare API Shield to validate incoming requests.

tags.name: Security
tags.description:
AI security and threat protection. All endpoints are protected against:
- Polyglot/Metadata Image attacks
- Sponge Attacks (DoS via expensive computation)
- Model Extraction & Inversion attempts
- Adversarial Input attacks (homoglyphs, invisible chars, RTL)
- Prompt Injection (direct and indirect via external content)

cancelImmediately.description: Whether to cancel the subscription immediately

cancelAtPeriodEnd.description: Whether to cancel at the end of the billing period

post.summary: Create setup intent for new payment method
Initiate x402 crypto payment for subscription

402.description: Payment required with crypto payment details

get.summary: Get nonce for payment wallet verification
get.description:
Generates a unique nonce/message for the user to sign with their wallet.
This is for payment verification only - does NOT save the wallet address to the account.
Different from /api/settings/wallet/bind which permanently links a wallet.

post.description:
Verifies the signature from the user's wallet for payment purposes.
This does NOT save the wallet address to the account - it only verifies
ownership for the current payment transaction.

Settles a signed x402 payment on-chain via the Cronos Facilitator.
This verifies the payment signature and executes the transfer.

get.summary: Get message to sign for wallet verification
get.description:
Generates a unique nonce/message for the user to sign with their wallet.
This is used to verify wallet ownership before crypto payments.

post.summary: Verify wallet signature and link to account
post.description:
Verifies the signature from the user's wallet and links the wallet
address to the user's account for future crypto payments.

Deletes the user account permanently. Requires re-authentication:
- Password is always required
- If 2FA is enabled, twoFactorToken is required
- If 2FA is not enabled, emailOtp is required (request via /api/account/delete/send-otp)

emailOtp.description: 6-digit email OTP code (required if 2FA not enabled)

post.summary: Send OTP for account deletion verification
post.description:
Sends an OTP code to the user's email for account deletion verification.
Only available for users without 2FA enabled. Rate limited to 3 requests per 10 minutes.

409.description: Wallet already connected to another account

post.summary: Send OTP for wallet binding verification
post.description: Sends OTP to user's email for wallet binding without 2FA

post.summary: Send OTP for wallet unbinding verification
post.description: Sends OTP to user's email for wallet unbinding without 2FA

get.summary: Get nonce for wallet signature verification

post.description:
Uploads a file using multipart/form-data.
Request body validation is not supported by Cloudflare API Shield.
Protection is handled via session authentication and server-side validation.

**Security Protection:**
- Polyglot attack detection (PHP, JS, Shell, ELF, PE, Java embedded in images)
- Metadata injection scanning (EXIF, XMP, Comments with malicious content)
- LLM token detection in metadata fields
- File signature validation

400.description: File rejected due to security concerns (polyglot/metadata attack detected)

get.summary: Get signed URL for R2 object access
get.description:
Generates a short-lived (15 min) signed URL for accessing private R2 objects.
Requires authentication.
Returns list of archived conversations for the authenticated user

get.summary: Check and downgrade expired x402 subscriptions
get.description:
Cron job that runs every 6 hours to check for expired x402 subscriptions
and downgrade users to the free tier. Requires CRON_SECRET authorization.

get.summary: Check if a Relay swap has been completed
get.description:
Checks if a specific swap request has already been executed.
Used to prevent double-execution of the same swap.

post.summary: Mark a Relay swap as completed
post.description:
Records that a swap has been executed to prevent re-execution.
Idempotent - calling multiple times will not create duplicate records.

transactionHash.description: Transaction hash of the executed swap

get.description: Public on-chain data - no auth required for shared chats

get.summary: Get NFT portfolio overview from Zerion

post.description:
Creates a chat completion with AI security protection.

**Security Protection:**
- Prompt injection detection (direct attacks in user messages)
- Sponge attack detection (token bombing, nested structures, expensive computation)
- Model extraction/inversion attempt detection
- Adversarial input detection (homoglyphs, invisible characters, RTL override)
- Risk score calculation (blocked if >= 50)

**External Content Protection:**
- Web search results are sanitized for indirect injection
- Scraped content is scanned for LLM manipulation tokens
- Hidden instructions in HTML comments/metadata are removed
